name: Cash+ Visa Signature Card
pay_over_time_fee: A monthly fee up to 1.60% of the original principal amount, for U.S. Bank ExtendPay Plan or Loan balances

welcome_bonus.requirement: after you spend $1,000 in eligible purchases within the first 90 days of account opening

verdict.text: Keep if you'll enroll new categories: flexible 5%/2% picks

earn_rates.category: Two categories you choose each quarter: fast food, home utilities, TV, internet and streaming, department stores, cell phone, electronics stores, sporting goods, furniture stores, movie theaters, ground transportation, gyms/fitness centers, or select clothing stores (first $2,000 combined, then 1%)
Prepaid air, hotel & car, Travel Center only
One everyday category you choose: gas/EV, grocery stores and grocery delivery, or restaurants

earn_note: Categories must be actively enrolled each quarter; miss the deadline and everything defaults to 1%. The two 5% picks come from a list of 12 (fast food, home utilities, TV, internet and streaming, department stores, cell phone, electronics stores, sporting goods, furniture stores, movie theaters, ground transportation, gyms/fitness centers, select clothing stores); the 2% pick is limited to gas/EV charging, grocery stores and grocery delivery, or restaurants. Discount stores/supercenters and wholesale clubs are excluded from grocery- and gas-category bonus rates, and grocery stores are also excluded from the gas category.

redemption_options.method: Deposit to a U.S. Bank checking or savings account

points.note: Cash back is worth its full value as a statement credit or a deposit to an eligible U.S. Bank account; gift cards and other options may be worth a different amount. The real value lever isn't redemption, it's the earn rate: max out the single $2,000/quarter cap shared across both 5% picks, and the blended rate on $8,000/year of category spend plus 1% elsewhere lands well above a flat 2% card.

transfer_partners.highlight: No transfer currency: straight cash back, not a points program.

insurance.detail: Not responsible for unauthorized transactions once reported

protection_note: U.S. Bank doesn't publish a purchase-protection or extended-warranty guide for this card the way it does for Shield, so check your actual Guide to Benefits after approval rather than assuming standard Visa Signature protections apply.
rental_note: No auto rental coverage documented publicly for this card as of this writing.

services.name: U.S. Bank ExtendPay Plan
services.detail: Pay off up to 50% of your credit line in fixed installments with a $0 fee offer for plans opened in the first 60 days.

services.name: Cash-back deals
services.detail: Personalized merchant offers in the U.S. Bank Mobile App based on past spending, stacked on top of the base earn rate.

additional_cards.title: Authorized users

benefits.text: Earns cash back on their spend (into your account)

additional_cards.note: No cost to add users: spend still counts toward the same $2,000/quarter category caps as the primary cardholder's.
